name: Run Autosite
description: Runs AutoSite on a PDB file to identify potential binding sites and returns a research log with the results.
detailed_description: Runs AutoSite on a PDB file to identify potential binding sites and returns a research log with the results.
when_to_use: When you need run autosite analysis

parameters.pdb_file: [Required] Path to the input PDB file (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Required] Directory where AutoSite results will be saved (str)
parameters.spacing: [Optional] Grid spacing parameter for AutoSite calculation (default: 1.0)
